newsitem.title: CANADA: Search Energy raises C$1 mln in warrants.
newsitem.headline: Search Energy raises C$1 mln in warrants.

text.p: Search Energy Inc said on Thursday its offer of 600,000 special warrants closed on November 7, raising C$1.08 million, a company statement said.
The warrants were sold by First Marathon Securities Ltd.
The proceeds from the special warrants will be used by Search to incur exploration and development expenses which will be renounced to the purchasers of the special warrants on a flow-through basis.
The funds will be spent in the Alameda, Stoughton and Steelman areas of Southeastern Saskatchewan, which are all core operating areas of Search.
Search is an emerging oil and gas producer with properties in Alberta and Saskatchewan.
